svg.title: Rule editor and backtest
svg.desc: Pulsus Dash alert rule authoring: PromQL query for payments to psp-api failed ratio, condition above 5 % for 5m with keep-firing and NoData/Error policies, a 7-day backtest with would-have-fired periods shaded, state and notification lanes, 6 firings and 14 notifications, matched incidents, a flapping warning with suggested fixes, labels, a live routing preview and a Slack notification preview.

g.text: from viewport “payments → psp-api failed %” · Inspector › Create alert

text.tspan: 6 transitions on Nov 14, 09:52–10:31 while the value oscillated around 5 % (3 of the 6 firings).
